premises.text: Physical inspection of every hive does not scale across large multi-site operations

premises.text: Sensor devices plus AI deliver remote hive status for proactive decisions

premises.text: Multi-signal sensing is translated into an understandable keeper interface
premises.evidence_span: translate it into an interface understandable by us humans

value.text: Profitable apiaries with thriving hives through better remote decisions
